cases.assumptions: Ordinary consumption entry; steel article; no US-metal, Chapter 98, Section 301 exclusion, FTZ or other claim. Actual-source rules resolve Section 232 at 25%, China drug-emergency IEEPA at 20%, Section 301 at 25%, and zero reciprocal liability. Wide rate_ieepa_recip is the pre-stacking 10% parameter, not payable reciprocal duty. Compare named program parameters only; base, AD/CVD and a complete total are not certified. May entry uses full-article steel basis, not modeled metal share.
